business_logic: 1. GET list: paginate sesuai shared-decisions.pagination, hitung company_count via COUNT company WHERE corporate_id

2. POST create: validate corporate_code required+unique → validate name required+unique → validate logo (jika ada) format/ukuran → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR → simpan logo ke Laravel Filesystem jika ada → insert Corporate baru dengan seluruh field profil

3. PATCH update: validate id exists → if not: return 404 NOT_FOUND → validate corporate_code required+unique (exclude self) → validate name required+unique (exclude self) → validate logo (jika diganti) → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR → update Corporate dengan seluruh field profil
4. DELETE: validate id exists → if not: return 404 NOT_FOUND → count Company WHERE corporate_id=id → if count > 0: return 409 CORPORATE_HAS_COMPANIES → else delete Corporate

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when creating Corporate with empty or duplicate corporate_code
unit_test_cases.given: input corporate_code is empty, or CorporateRepository.existsByCode(code) returns true
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with errors.corporate_code populated; http 422, error_code VALIDATION_ERROR

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when creating Corporate with empty or duplicate name
unit_test_cases.given: input name is empty, or CorporateRepository.existsByName(name) returns true
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with errors.name populated; http 422, error_code VALIDATION_ERROR

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when uploaded logo has an unsupported format or exceeds size limit
unit_test_cases.given: uploaded logo file is not jpg/png, or exceeds 2MB
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with errors.logo populated; http 422, error_code VALIDATION_ERROR; no file stored

unit_test_cases.description: returns 404 NOT_FOUND when updating Corporate with non-existent id
returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when updating Corporate with code or name already used by another Corporate
unit_test_cases.given: CorporateRepository.findById(id) returns an existing Corporate; CorporateRepository.existsByCodeExcludingId()/existsByNameExcludingId() returns true
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with errors.corporate_code or errors.name populated; http 422, error_code VALIDATION_ERROR

unit_test_cases.description: returns 404 NOT_FOUND when deleting Corporate with non-existent id
returns 409 CORPORATE_HAS_COMPANIES when deleting Corporate that still has related Company records
unit_test_cases.given: CorporateRepository.findById(id) returns an existing Corporate; CompanyRepository.countByCorporateId(id) returns 3 (> 0)
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ConflictException; http 409, error_code CORPORATE_HAS_COMPANIES; Corporate is not deleted

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result with full profile when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: CorporateRepository.existsByCode()/existsByName() (and Excluding variants) return false, logo validation passes or is omitted, CompanyRepository.countByCorporateId() returns 0 where relevant, CorporateRepository.save()/delete() persist successfully
unit_test_cases.expect: return the created/updated Corporate object with id, corporate_code, name, and all profile fields, company_count, created_at (or { deleted: true } for delete)

implementation_notes: 403 FORBIDDEN pada seluruh endpoint disimpulkan dari actor_permissions (bukan tercantum literal di business spec) — role selain Admin ditolak di level middleware/policy, bukan hanya UI hidden

Livewire component dapat memanggil Service Layer yang sama dengan REST API (arsitektur Layered per arch-spec) — endpoint /api/corporates di atas adalah kontrak untuk keperluan test/dokumentasi, implementasi FE boleh memanggil service langsung dari Livewire tanpa round-trip HTTP terpisah, konsisten dengan pola screen-016/017/018

REWORK ver 2 (2026-08-19, adopsi ERD docs/MMS_Weighbridge_ERD_Operational_MVP_v3.1.mermaid): id tetap uuid sebagai primary key/FK (TIDAK diganti corporate_code) — lihat entity-catalog v4 derived-assumptions untuk alasan lengkap (menghindari cascading FK-type change ke Station/User yang sudah diimplementasikan). corporate_code ditambahkan sebagai field unik terpisah. 17 field profil baru (kontak/legal/kepegawaian/logo) ditambahkan, seluruhnya opsional kecuali corporate_code dan name. unit_test_cases diperluas dari 6 (ver 1) menjadi 8 untuk mencakup validasi corporate_code dan logo.
Logo disimpan di Laravel Filesystem local disk (konsisten dengan machinery.picture_url), path/URL disimpan di kolom logo, diekspos di response sebagai logo_url
